title: Benefit Year Maximums and Deductibles Carried by Each Rider
content:
The benefit-year accumulator on an Optional Supplemental Benefit Rider is kept against the figures below. Each figure is a term of the rider held, not of the member's medical plan.

| Rider | Benefit year maximum (USD) | Lifetime maximum (USD) | Benefit year deductible (USD) | Combined maximum across every rider held (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 750.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 4500.00 |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 400.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 4500.00 |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 2500.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 4500.00 |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 1500.00 | 0.00 | 50.00 | 4500.00 |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 3000.00 | 0.00 | 75.00 | 4500.00 |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 4000.00 | 0.00 | 50.00 | 4500.00 |

## The figures defined

**Benefit year maximum.** The most the rider will pay in one benefit year, in USD.

**Lifetime maximum.** The most the rider will pay over the life of the rider, in USD. A figure of zero is carried where there is no lifetime limit, and every rider in this schedule carries zero.

**Benefit year deductible.** The deductible taken each benefit year before the rider pays, in USD.

**Combined maximum.** The most every rider a member holds will pay between them in one benefit year, in USD. The figure is the same 4500.00 USD on all six riders.

## Benefit categories the deductible is taken on

The deductible is taken only on the benefit categories the rider names for it.

| Rider | Categories the deductible is taken on |
|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | none |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | none |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | none |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | basic restorative dental care, major restorative dental care, root canal treatment, gum treatment, oral surgery, dentures and implants |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | basic restorative dental care, major restorative dental care, root canal treatment, gum treatment, oral surgery, dentures and implants |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | basic restorative dental care, major restorative dental care, root canal treatment, gum treatment, oral surgery, dentures and implants |

The three riders carrying a deductible of 0.00 USD name no category for it. The three that carry one name the same seven categories, and preventive dental care is not among them on any rider.
